blocks.label: Slack C - questions or quiet completion

labs.title: Preflight and landing
labs.outcome: Know your usable environment, access limits, and safe fallback.
labs.workspace: Read-only checkout; installation belongs before the day.
labs.lanes: Supported: tested usable route. Core: green local baseline and capability card. Extension: one policy-owner map.

labs.title: Operator model
labs.outcome: Choose a workflow and verify claims without editing code.
labs.first: Open [the invariants](reference/invariants.md) and choose one calculation.
labs.workspace: Read-only checkout; do not repair code in this lab.
labs.lanes: Supported: two claims, one verified. Core: three claims, two verified. Both: one open claim and uncertainty. Extension: narrower comparison.

labs.title: Guided incident
labs.outcome: Reproduce, bound, review, and explain one incident.
labs.lanes: Supported: located path and reviewed next action; full check may fail. Core: repair, independent regression, passing check. Extension: one adjacent invariant.

labs.title: Plan-driven migration
labs.outcome: Preserve a public contract through small reviewed batches.
labs.lanes: Supported: baseline, edited plan, one verified batch, handover. Core: full migration and contract comparison pass. Extension: one narrow risk check.

labs.title: Review unattended work
labs.outcome: Write independent findings, compare automated review, and decide.
labs.workspace: Only workshop/scenarios/review-pr/work/review_notes.md; do not apply the patch.
labs.lanes: Supported: two findings and captured comparison. Core: three findings and passing structure check. Both: own decision and uncertainty. Extension: recurrence control.

labs.title: Choose one elective
labs.outcome: Test one control, its negative case, and its limits.
labs.first: Choose 5A, 5B, or 5C below; start only that branch. If unsure, choose 5C.
labs.workspace: The selected elective's work/ directory only.
labs.lanes: Supported: one positive and one negative case plus decision. Core: branch checklist and structure check. Extension: one follow-up question only.

labs.title: Secure MCP context
labs.outcome: Reduce one proposed configuration and trace which layer controls each event.
labs.lanes: Supported: first three branch items and two event types. Core: all branch items and structure check. Extension: follow-up only.

labs.title: CLI permissions
labs.outcome: Trace a proposed permission policy and identify what it cannot restrict.
labs.lanes: Supported: first three branch items and traced negative event. Core: all branch items and structure check. Extension: follow-up only.

labs.title: Useful customization
labs.outcome: Rewrite and test three to five instruction rules on one stable task.
labs.lanes: Supported: first three branch items and one contradiction. Core: all branch items and structure check. Extension: follow-up only.

labs.title: Independent capstone
labs.outcome: Build your own bounded map, test a change, review it, and explain uncertainty.
labs.lanes: Supported: stated bounded checks and handover; service output may remain unfinished. Core: full suite, own risk check, review, private rubric. Extension: one extra check.

labs.title: Close and next action
labs.outcome: Keep a return-later pointer, one engineering habit, and three dated commitments.
labs.first: Open your private Lab 6 note or archive pointer; do not restart the scenario.
labs.workspace: Private notes only; no employer code or internal identifiers.
labs.lanes: Supported: use the supplied habit card. Core: tailor it with evidence and dates. Both: three commitments. Extension: pilot proposal after the workshop.
